items.headline: Synopsys shares drop after weak design IP revenue and softer earnings outlook; company cites U.S. export restrictions weighing on China business
Synopsys reports Q2 FY2026 results: EPS $3.35 vs. $3.15 expected and revenue $2.276B vs. $2.25B expected; stock trades lower despite beats
Synopsys to report second quarter fiscal 2026 financial results after market close on May 27, 2026
